title: ID0418167-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003620] Outlet 2 is blocked because the LEM meter outputs
description:
Reported issue:
This ticket refers to the already closed ticketID0393637. This was closed too early. I think the reversed voltage problem was confused with the BYD 0kW session problem. The course of our deployments is relatively well visible in the ticket timeline. Problem: We received the order from HQ to perform the H&S temp. sensor wiring on three chargers. This is a very important rewiring of the first 400KW chargers, as without this the performance is limited and at OMV mainly trucks want to charge. The email is attached. The strange problem is that every time we perform the wiring, Outlet 2 is blocked because the LEM meter outputs "reversed voltage". Permanently. See screenshots attached. THE WIRING OF THE TEMP. SENSOR SHOULD HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH THE METER! These are not related.
Solution:

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0418167-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003620] Outlet 2 is blocked because the LEM meter outputs CRM:02678000055
additional_info.body:
Hi Gary,
Attached I send you the original e-mail from Tesch Lea.
The Charger is under Beta Testing (FW 6.1.3). But the “BYD 0kWh session” has nothing to do with our “reversed Voltage” LEM. If we have our fault, its permanently on the LEM Meter. And it only occurs in SCB if we do the rewiring.
We didn’t have this fault on the other two chargers where we did the rewiring.
So, something is wrong with this charger. Maybe the LEM but we must be sure about this. To change it on an ERK-Charger is not that easy.
Now the ticket is open, I will write a field service report from our last visit. Then the documentation should be complete.
BR
Daniel
